prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-21, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-05-21):
| Return 3m            | +12.6% |
| Return 1m            | +5.3% |
| Return 1w            | +2.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 100% |
| 21d realized vol     | 27% |
| Last close           | 57.25 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has been in a solid uptrend, evidenced by +12.6% over the last 3 months and recent +5.3% monthly gains, suggesting momentum and potential continued upside over the next few weeks. While 21-day realized volatility is elevated (27%), the persistent positive flow and tight recent performance support a constructive near-term path. Given the current momentum and favorable setup, a bullish stance is warranted for the next ~20 trading days.

DECISION: BUY
